channel.title: Captions Gen news
channel.description: Updates to Captions Gen for Premiere Pro and After Effects.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.13: edit captions in the Premiere panel
item.description: Edit caption text in Premiere without leaving Captions Gen. Changes that keep the same word count preserve the existing highlight timing.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.11: Windows speech-model recovery and clearer diagnostics
item.description: Recover built-in models when Windows blocks cached model links, with clearer diagnostics and support emails that retain the stored log excerpt.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.10: separate installation counts and optional usage stats
item.description: Installation registration is separate from optional usage statistics. Existing opt-outs are preserved, with active sessions only after you allow stats.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.9: now in After Effects
item.description: Install Captions Gen for Premiere Pro, After Effects, or both with one Windows setup. Shared speech models, editable captions and panel-aware updates.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.8: custom models and better caption edits
item.description: Choose compatible custom speech models, search spoken languages, retime edited captions and apply styles to an existing caption batch.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.4: clearer model status and loading errors
item.description: More accurate model readiness checks for custom caches, clearer model-loading errors, and improved handling of custom Python settings during updates.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1.2: animate edited words, with cleaner controls
item.description: Update word animation after editing caption text in Premiere, including added words. Plus a quieter panel and fixes for caption grouping, placement and installation.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.1: now free, with 18 new caption looks
item.description: The 15-minute limit is gone: Captions Gen is now free. Plus 18 presets with the looks creators use, free fonts, instant previews and a simpler panel.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.0.9: cleaner outlines and timing that follows speech
item.description: Outlines no longer cut through neighbouring letters, letter spacing is in real pixels, captions wait for the next word after a pause, and you can report a bug from Settings.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.0.7 and 1.0.8: start the engine from the panel
item.description: When the caption engine isn't running, the panel now has a Start engine button, so you no longer need the Start menu.

item.title: Captions Gen 1.0.6: works in Premiere Pro in any language
item.description: Fixes empty caption boxes in non-English Premiere Pro, makes Text case work on the timeline, and stops free minutes being counted twice for the same clip.

item.title: Captions Gen is out: animated captions inside Premiere Pro
item.description: Captions Gen launches: local transcription, word-by-word karaoke captions as editable Motion Graphics, animation presets, and in-app updates.
